gloss: to pass through; to transit; to go through

definitions.gloss: to pass through (a place); to go past without stopping
definitions.explanation: To move through or past a location without stopping there. Commonly used for trains passing through stations, vehicles passing through areas, or storms passing over regions.

definitions.gloss: to pass (a test, inspection, or legislative process)
definitions.explanation: To successfully get through a review, screening, or approval process.

examples.japanese: この{電車|でんしゃ}は{次|つぎ}の{駅|えき}を{通過|つうか}します。
examples.english: This train will pass through the next station without stopping.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{関東|かんとう}{地方|ちほう}を{通過|つうか}した。
examples.english: The typhoon passed through the Kanto region.

examples.japanese: {高速道路|こうそくどうろ}の{料金所|りょうきんじょ}を{通過|つうか}するのに{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: It took time to pass through the expressway toll gate.

examples.japanese: {法案|ほうあん}が{国会|こっかい}を{通過|つうか}した。
examples.english: The bill passed through the Diet.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}{審査|しんさ}を{通過|つうか}して、{面接|めんせつ}に{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: I passed the document screening and moved on to the interview.

examples.japanese: {厳|きび}しい{審査|しんさ}を{通過|つうか}した{作品|さくひん}だけが{展示|てんじ}される。
examples.english: Only works that pass the strict screening will be exhibited.

notes:
A versatile verb with both physical (passing through a place) and abstract (passing a screening) meanings. Very common in news, train announcements, and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通過|つうか}{駅|えき}: a station the train passes through
- {通過|つうか}{点|てん}: a passing point; a milestone
- {通過|つうか}{儀礼|ぎれい}: rite of passage
- {審査|しんさ}を{通過|つうか}する: to pass a screening
- {国会|こっかい}を{通過|つうか}する: to pass through parliament

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {通|とお}る: to pass / to go through — more general and casual; used in everyday speech
- {通|つう}じる: to lead to / to be understood — focuses on connection or communication
- {経由|けいゆ}する: to go via / to transit through — emphasizes the route taken

USAGE:
On Japanese trains, station announcements frequently say この{電車|でんしゃ}は〇〇{駅|えき}を{通過|つうか}します to warn passengers that the express train won't stop at certain stations.
